indicator_definition: This indicator measures the total agricultural area under organic farming, including both fully certified organic land and land currently in the conversion period. It is expressed as a percentage of the total utilised agricultural area (UAA). Data are based on national organic farming statistics compiled by Eurostat.
rationale: Organic farming promotes biodiversity, reduces the use of synthetic pesticides and fertilisers, and supports sustainable soil and water management. Increasing the share of organic farmland is an important step towards more sustainable and resilient food production systems.
methodology_characteristics: Data are collected through national farm surveys and agricultural statistics, compiled in accordance with EU organic farming regulations. Figures include land fully certified as organic as well as land in the conversion period, typically lasting two to three years.
